title: Design System: RCCG School of Disciples (Americas-1)

body.purpose: General copy, table cells, and narrative text.

label.purpose: Form labels, button text, and metadata captions.

shadows.name: card-subtle

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary cobalt action button for form submission and key portal actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif; height: 40px; padding: 0 32px; border-radius: 6px; background: #001EC5; color: #FFFFFF; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; border: none; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; transition: background 0.15s ease, transform 0.1s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #00189E; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #001EC5; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outlined Button
components.description: Secondary outlined button with cobalt border for non-primary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-outlined { font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif; height: 40px; padding: 0 32px; border-radius: 6px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #001EC5; border: 1px solid #001EC5; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; transition: background 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-outlined:hover { background: rgba(0, 30, 197, 0.06); } .ds-btn-outlined:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #001EC5; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Public Nav CTA
components.description: Warm amber pill CTA used in the public navigation bar.
components.css: .ds-btn-nav-cta { font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif; background: #FFC107; color: #22272F; border-radius: 20px; padding: 6px 20px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: filter 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-nav-cta:hover { filter: brightness(0.95); } .ds-btn-nav-cta:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #001F54; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Labeled text field with Deep Navy label and 6px rounded border.
components.css: .ds-input-wrap { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif; } .ds-input-label { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: #001F54; } .ds-input { width: 100%; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid #C9C9C9; padding: 12px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: #22272F; background: #FFFFFF; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #C9C9C9; font-weight: 400; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #001EC5; }

narrative.overview:
RCCG School of Disciples (Americas-1) balances the welcoming warmth of a church discipleship community with the clarity and accountability of an academic institution. Public surfaces invite prospective students into a clear, trustworthy story, while authenticated student, coordinator, and admin portals prioritize scanability, disciplined hierarchy, and zero-ambiguity form and payment workflows.

The system is grounded in a crisp, flat-by-default visual language: high-legibility geometric sans-serif typography (`Poppins`), authoritative deep-navy and cobalt-blue anchors, and restrained warm amber reserved for primary public calls to action.
keyCharacteristics: Geometric clarity with Poppins across every display, form, and operational surface.
High-contrast cobalt and deep-navy authority paired with clean white and subtle cool-gray surfaces.
Flat-by-default containers separated by crisp 1px hairline borders rather than heavy drop shadows.
Responsive, mobile-first clarity for students registering and checking results on any device.

rules.name: The Cobalt-For-Action Rule
rules.body: Reserve Primary Cobalt for interactive controls, active selections, and key academic identifiers (like matric numbers); never flood entire backgrounds with it.

rules.name: The Amber-CTA Rule
rules.body: Warm Amber Gold appears on the public navigation CTA and status indicators, never as a generic body background.

rules.name: The Single-Family Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Establish contrast through weight (400, 500, 600) and ink tone (#001F54 vs. #22272F vs. #64748B) rather than mixing additional font families.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Cards and data panels rest flat with 1px hairline borders; reserve elevation for overlays, dropdowns, and intentional hover feedback.

dos: Do use Primary Cobalt (#001EC5) for primary buttons, active states, and key student identifiers.
Do pair form inputs with Deep Navy (#001F54) labels and 6px (rounded-md) corners.
Do keep cards flat with 1px borders and clean whitespace (space-y-6).
Do preserve official RCCG/SOD logos and leadership photography from public/images/.
donts: Don't introduce competing font families outside Poppins.
Don't stack heavy drop shadows on every card or table container.
Don't use Crimson Alert (#FF3739) for non-destructive actions.
Don't hide essential student actions (registration, payment status, results) behind hover-only interactions on mobile.
